import glob, re, collections
errors, done = set(), set()
pat = re.compile(r"\b(req-\d+)\b")
for f in glob.glob("logs/app-*.log"):
    for line in open(f):
        m = pat.search(line)
        if not m: continue
        rid = m.group(1)
        if " ERROR " in line: errors.add(rid)
        elif " done " in line: done.add(rid)
stuck = sorted(errors - done)
import os
os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
open("out/stuck.txt", "w").write("\n".join(stuck) + ("\n" if stuck else ""))
print(len(errors), "error reqs,", len(stuck), "stuck:", stuck)

def stuck():
    """Compute stuck request ids from logs/app-*.log and write out/stuck.txt; print the result."""
    import glob, re, os
    errors, done = set(), set()
    pat = re.compile(r"\b(req-\d+)\b")
    for f in glob.glob("logs/app-*.log"):
        for line in open(f):
            m = pat.search(line)
            if not m: continue
            rid = m.group(1)
            if " ERROR " in line: errors.add(rid)
            elif " done " in line: done.add(rid)
    stuck = sorted(errors - done)
    os.makedirs("out", exist_ok=True)
    with open("out/stuck.txt", "w") as out:
        out.write("\n".join(stuck) + ("\n" if stuck else ""))
    print(f"{len(errors)} error reqs, {len(stuck)} stuck: {stuck}")
    return stuck
